system.name: Activation Oracles (AOs)
system.one_liner: LLMs trained, LatentQA-style, to take another model's activations as input and answer natural-language questions about them, shown on a hidden-objective Taboo model.

content.variant_note: two numbered steps on one real chat example: collect activations at the assistant token, inject them into oracle prompts and read the answers
content.argues: An Activation Oracle can reveal a hidden objective and a secret word from a model's activations, although the model itself refuses to say them.
content.subject: A Taboo-finetuned suspect model refusing to reveal the word 'tree', and two oracle questions about its activations with the oracle's answers.

evidence: A suspect model is fine-tuned to play the game Taboo
We inject these activations into new prompts and ask natural language questions about them
reveals both the suspect model’s goal and the secret word

summary: Activation Oracles are LLMs trained to read another model's activations and answer natural-language questions about them. Figure 1 shows one real example in two numbered steps. On the left a suspect model, fine-tuned to play Taboo with the secret word 'tree', refuses to reveal it, and its activations at the assistant token are collected. A red dashed connector carries them into two oracle prompts on the right, each starting with a red-boxed <activation> slot followed by a question. Pale-yellow answer bubbles, each beside a crystal-ball icon, give the model's goal and the secret word. A dashed note states how the suspect model was trained, and grey and blue bubbles mark the roles.
summary_zh: 激活预言机是读取另一个模型激活并用自然语言回答问题的大模型。图一用两步展示一个真实例子：先收集拒绝泄露秘密词“tree”的可疑模型在助手词元处的激活，再用红色虚线把激活注入两个提问，预言机的黄色回答揭示了模型目标和秘密词。
notes: No paragraph of the paper mentions the figure, so the record rests on the caption, the abstract and the figure itself; the caption describes both steps in detail. The crystal ball is read as the Activation Oracle because the caption names the oracle and the icon is unlabelled.
